$comment: Michael's own apps for ops/apps.mjs. kind electron-release: installs the latest GitHub release (macOS .zip into /Applications, Windows NSIS .exe silently). needs: tools each OS must have before install (ids in apps.mjs TOOLS). kind code-repo: clones/pulls the repo into the apps folder and sets it up (npm ci, or a .venv for a pyproject.toml); nothing is deployed. kind script-repo: clones/pulls the repo into the apps folder, then runs the hook for this OS (.sh with sh, .ps1 with PowerShell) from the repo folder.
